examples.title: 도트 · 대기
examples.description: 치비 아니메 도트 캐릭터의 작은 호흡과 머리카락 움직임
examples.note: 같은 치비 아니메 도트 캐릭터로 생성 후 도트화·윤곽·시간축을 정리한 실제 샘플입니다. 걷기의 반복 구간은 생성 후 골랐습니다.

recipe.prompt: A very small relaxed idle loop in the original orientation. Both boots stay planted, with tiny shoulder and torso sway, no local inflation. Hair tips follow gently. Keep the same chibi head-to-body proportions, pixel face and eyes, costume, colors and original rigid weapon pose. No stepping, turning, sword swings, added effects or camera motion.

examples.note: 같은 치비 아니메 도트 캐릭터로 생성 후 도트화·윤곽·시간축을 정리한 실제 샘플입니다. 걷기의 반복 구간은 생성 후 골랐습니다.

recipe.prompt: Walk in place toward screen right with a short even stride and small opposite arm swing. Preserve the exact reference chibi character, large head and compact body, original eyes and face, costume, pixel clusters, palette and one rigid existing sword. No changing proportions, extra weapon, camera motion, scenery or effects.

examples.title: 도트 · 검 공격
examples.description: 같은 캐릭터로 한 번 베기 → 자세 회복
examples.note: 같은 치비 아니메 도트 캐릭터로 생성 후 도트화·윤곽·시간축을 정리한 실제 샘플입니다. 걷기의 반복 구간은 생성 후 골랐습니다.

recipe.prompt: Perform exactly ONE clear sword attack toward SCREEN RIGHT, then recover. At 0.0-0.4 seconds brace the boots, bend the knees and draw the sword hand back and up beside the rear shoulder. At 0.4-0.95 seconds deliver ONE fast decisive diagonal downward cut through the space in front toward screen right. Move the arm, shoulders and hips with one small grounded weight shift. At 0.95-1.35 seconds follow through low and forward, then brake. At 1.35-2.2 seconds recover the opening compact ready stance at the same screen location and hold until the end. Keep the exact reference chibi head and body proportions, pixel face and eyes, costume, colors and square pixel clusters. Keep one rigid sword in the same hand, unchanged in length. No duplicate weapon, second attack, walking, jumping, full body spin, camera motion or scenery. Keep the whole character, sword and effects inside the empty canvas.

examples.title: 일반 · 대기
examples.description: 일반 비율 캐릭터의 작은 호흡과 머리카락 움직임
examples.note: 같은 일반 비율 캐릭터로 만든 실제 동작 예시입니다. 내 캐릭터의 실시간 미리보기가 아닙니다.

recipe.prompt: A subtle continuous combat-ready idle. Both boots remain planted. Small relaxed whole-torso sway and slight shoulder breathing, with hair tips and skirt hem following after the body. Keep the abdomen and jacket volume constant. Hold the same rigid sword in the opening diagonal-down ready pose. Preserve the normal adult proportions, exact face, single visible green eye, costume, colors and fine anime linework. No stepping, sword swings, speaking, blinking, chibi proportions or pixelation.

examples.title: 일반 · 뛰기
examples.description: 전진 기울기와 팔·다리 동작이 있는 제자리 달리기
examples.note: 같은 일반 비율 캐릭터로 만든 실제 동작 예시입니다. 내 캐릭터의 실시간 미리보기가 아닙니다. 다리·팔 사이까지 AI로 배경을 제거했습니다. 칼을 수납하고 양손을 비운 채 뛰는 예시입니다. 1.5배속으로 재생하며, 칼집·의상의 작은 흔들림과 반복 경계는 남습니다.

recipe.prompt: Run vigorously IN PLACE toward screen RIGHT with alternating long running strides and a short airborne phase between contacts. The sword is fully SHEATHED and firmly strapped to the waist belt; the hilt and scabbard move rigidly with the pelvis. Both hands are EMPTY closed fists. Pump BOTH bent arms forward and backward opposite their corresponding legs. Drive one knee forward while the opposite heel folds behind, then SWITCH legs completely. Each foot lands underneath the hip, pushes back, lifts and passes forward; neither leg stays permanently in front. Lean the torso forward and counterrotate the shoulders and hips, with rhythmic small vertical rise and fall. Ponytail and skirt whip after each push-off. Maintain the exact same adult woman, face, costume, colors and cel shading, rightward gaze and static side-view camera. No drawing the weapon, sword in hands, hopping on one foot, skating, walking, pauses or camera motion. Continue a clear alternating gait throughout the ending.

examples.title: 일반 · 빠른 내려찍기
examples.description: 칼을 들어 올린 자세에서 짧고 빠르게 내려찍기
examples.note: 같은 일반 비율 캐릭터로 만든 실제 동작 예시입니다. 내 캐릭터의 실시간 미리보기가 아닙니다. 다리·팔 사이까지 AI로 배경을 제거했습니다. 칼을 들어 올린 입력 자세에서 약 0.23초에 내려찍는 단발 예시입니다. 앞뒤 멈춤 정리와 2배속을 적용했습니다. 손·검의 작은 변형은 남습니다.

recipe.prompt: IMMEDIATELY execute ONE explosive downward sword SMASH toward screen RIGHT from the already raised sword pose. No extra preparation or slow lifting. During the first instant the rear leg drives, the front boot stamps down and the hips and shoulders snap together; both hands shoot from above the head sharply DOWN to the front hip. The rigid sword describes one fast steep downward arc, with impact reached almost immediately. Drop the pelvis by bending the knees, brace the front leg and stop the sword low just ahead of the front ankle. Keep the chest up and spine firm: do not bow, slump or hinge at the waist. Elbows fold at the finish. Ponytail and skirt whip violently then settle. One crisp strike only, no repeated swing, fencing thrust, shuffle, jumping or slow motion. Hold a grounded low finish briefly. Same exact adult character, face, outfit and colors, one rigid short sword in both hands, unchanged blade length. Keep the whole blade arc and both boots inside the empty canvas, no effects or camera movement.

examples.title: 일반 · 작은 검기 · 베기
examples.description: 검을 휘두를 때 짧고 옅은 검기가 따라오는 동작
examples.note: 샘플 캐릭터의 실제 생성 결과입니다. 내 이미지를 넣고 이 설정으로 만들 수 있어요. 일부 프레임에 작은 원형 빛이 잠깐 생겨요.

recipe.prompt: Immediately make one quick downward sword cut to screen right from the raised starting pose. Plant the forward boot, flex the knees and drive both hands from overhead down to the forward hip. The cut happens during the first half second. Keep the chest lifted and stop in a stable low finishing stance. Hold the finish as the hair settles.

examples.title: 일반 · 작은 검기 · 회전베기
examples.description: 몸을 돌려 공격하고 옅은 칼날 빛으로 마무리
examples.note: 샘플 캐릭터의 실제 생성 결과입니다. 내 이미지를 넣고 이 설정으로 만들 수 있어요. 회전 마무리는 찌르기에 가깝고, 가는 빛 끝이 화면 가장자리에 닿아요.

recipe.prompt: Sink onto bent knees, then make one quick full-body turn on two short planted steps. Show the back of the head and outfit during the turn, then face screen right again. The hips, shoulders and sword rotate together. Finish by planting the front boot and cutting horizontally to the right. Stop in a low balanced lunge and hold the finish.

examples.title: 치비 · 달리기
examples.description: 짧은 다리·팔과 망토가 함께 움직이는 오른쪽 달리기
examples.note: 오리지널 치비 캐릭터의 실제 생성 예시입니다. 내 캐릭터로 생성하면 결과가 달라져요. 별봉·가방에 작은 변형과 색 변화가 남으며 반복 경계는 확인이 필요해요.

recipe.prompt: Preserve the EXACT supplied chibi character, original face, eyes, hairstyle, costume colors, accessories, large head and compact short body, anime linework and painted texture. Run continuously IN PLACE toward SCREEN RIGHT for two or three energetic running strides. Already running at the first frame and still running at the last. Knees drive forward and the trailing heel folds back, alternating feet pass under the hip; include a brief airborne phase. Legs move forward/back along screen X, never spread sideways toward the camera. The empty arm pumps opposite the legs and shoulders counterrotate; hand holding the original prop stays near the hip. The short cape and satchels swing with delayed secondary motion. Keep the hip centered, nose right, same ground height and body scale. No idle pause, turn, skating or walking.  Fixed camera, full body and existing equipment inside the canvas. Uniform grey background, no floor, scenery or text.

examples.title: 치비 · 별봉 공격
examples.description: 앞으로 찌르는 한 번의 공격과 작은 금빛 불꽃
examples.note: 오리지널 치비 캐릭터의 실제 생성 예시입니다. 내 캐릭터로 생성하면 결과가 달라져요. 이 샘플은 생성 영상에서 첫 공격만 약 1.42초로 골랐어요. 새 결과도 필요한 공격 구간을 선택해 주세요. 얼굴은 정면에 가까운 3/4 시점이며 손·별봉에 작은 변형이 남아요.

recipe.prompt: Preserve the EXACT supplied chibi character, original face, eyes, hairstyle, costume colors, accessories, large head and compact short body, anime linework and painted texture. Perform ONE crisp wand attack toward SCREEN RIGHT. From the loaded stance, briefly bend the knees then push off the rear foot, stamp the leading boot and rotate hips and shoulders together. The wand arm drives the original rigid short star wand sharply forward-right in ONE decisive thrust, with the empty arm counterbalancing behind. The star tip reaches the space in front of her at chest height. A few tiny golden sparks appear at the star tip only at the instant of impact and vanish immediately; no beam, projectile or large explosion. Hold the balanced forward finish briefly, then recover to the opening stance. Cape and satchels lag and settle. One attack only; no repeated waving, spin, waist bow or extra weapon.  Fixed camera, full body and existing equipment inside the canvas. Uniform grey background, no floor, scenery or text.
